doc: Hints for the FAIL line of scripts/convert.py and scripts/check_bundle.py (scripts/failure_line.py). The first row whose stages contain the failing stage and whose regex (case-insensitive) matches the error text (the message, the traceback, model_type=<type>) gives the hint; otherwise a refusal's own action; otherwise a model request with the line. Add a row only with a measured case in `source`.

hints.hint: pass a commit sha, branch or tag that exists in the repo (huggingface.co/<org>/<model>/commits/main)
check the repo id (org/name) on huggingface.co; a private repo needs a token with read access (hf auth login or HF_TOKEN)
log in (hf auth login) or set HF_TOKEN, then rerun: the Hub rate-limits anonymous requests per IP
hints.source: anonymous /api/models requests answered 429 while token requests went through (2026-10-19)

hints.hint: delete that file's blob from the HF cache and rerun; for a multi-GB file that keeps arriving short, download it with ranged requests and check it against the Hub's sha256
hints.source: hf_hub_download delivered 0 bytes for some multi-GB files across retries (2026-08-24/25, 2026-09-05/06)

hints.hint: a hybrid model_type the released exporter has no model_ext for: the family recipe (README "Convert a finetune") or litert-torch main
hints.source: granite-4.0-h-350m finetune on 0.9.4: AttributeError 'linear_key_head_dim' (2026-08-25); Qwen3.5 on 0.9.3: update_conv_state TypeError (2026-08-24) - scripts/convert.py HYBRID_RECIPE / HYBRID_STOCK

hints.hint: a data-dependent branch in the model's forward stops torch.export; open a model request with the guard expression (scripts/convert.py normalize_static_alpha_rope removes one such branch by baking the config)
hints.source: tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B: GuardOnDataDependentSymNode on Eq(u0, 1) in the dynamic rope growth branch (2026-08-27)

hints.match: content read left unwrapped|differs from transformers|not what transformers renders
hints.hint: the template reads content or calls a method the 0.18 runtime cannot render, in a form the two edits (.get -> indexing, format_content on message.content / message['content'] / messages[0].content) do not reach: write its runtime form by hand (tools/chat_template_parts/), check it with scripts/chat_template_dual.py, then convert with it
hints.source: scripts/chat_template_dual.py (Qwen3-1.7B dual 7, SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct dual 1, gemma-4-E2B-it get 25; 2026-10-19)

hints.hint: the user's text did not reach the model: compare the runtime's render with transformers' (scripts/chat_template_dual.py --runtime-render <bundle>) before anything else
hints.source: Qwen3-1.7B stock bundle on litert-lm 0.18.0: the user turn rendered empty and the model answered about an empty message (2026-10-19)

hints.hint: the bundle loads but fails the 8-question gate: read gate.json in the output dir (which answers are wrong, whether they loop) before changing the recipe
the stage ran past --max-minutes: rerun without the cap to see whether it finishes, and give its seconds in the model request
uv sync (the pinned environment carries the litert-lm CLI), or set LITERT_LM_CLI
